purpose: Find nonzero bbox and crop/align the task020 5x5 local frame.
expected_cost_risk: medium-high; exp046 small bbox crop cost was 50589 for task031
implementation_note: Reuse exp046 style dynamic bbox crop first; later replace with task020-specific 10x10/bbox5 shortcuts.

purpose: For each nonzero color, compute group counts in corners, edge_mid, inner, center over the 5x5 frame.
expected_cost_risk: medium if done for all 9 colors; low if target color can be inferred cheaply
reject_pattern: MatMul signature over examples, per-example color table
implementation_note: Rule must stay color-role based. Do not use absolute target-color table.

purpose: Implement exp062 decision rule: corners_eq1 -> corners, edge_mid_eq1 -> edge_mid, has_inner -> inner_diag, else corners.
implementation_note: This is the core nonlookup rule and should remain tiny.

purpose: Select the unique D4 variant compatible with current target-color positions and fill exactly the three missing cells.
expected_cost_risk: medium; could explode if implemented separately for all colors/classes/variants
reject_pattern: large ScatterND coordinate table, MatMul over variants
implementation_note: Start with explicit masks for 3 template classes x D4 variants, then prune with compatibility.

purpose: Map 5x5 local fill mask back to 30x30 one-hot output.
preferred_ops: Pad/Gather or Where on full 30x30 tensor
expected_cost_risk: medium-high; full-grid Where may dominate memory
implementation_note: First implementation can use full-grid Where for correctness; cost pass will likely need sparse writeback.
